authors: F. Fiamberti, A. Santambrogio, C. Sieg
title: Five-loop anomalous dimension at critical wrapping order in N=4 SYM
claim: Five-loop anomalous dimension of a length-five operator in the planar SU(2) sector (critical wrapping order) computed with N=1 superspace perturbation theory; confirms the twist-three formula conjectured in 0901.4864 (Beccaria-Forini-Lukowski-Zieme) and is reproduced from the Y-system.
theory: planar N=4 SYM, SU(2) sector, length-5 operator
scheme: same strategy as S1a.02: N=1 superspace supergraphs, 4d D-algebra, dimensionally regularized integrals, MS-type pole extraction; non-wrapping part from the asymptotic dilatation operator/Bethe ansatz (details not re-verified for this paper)
symmetry_argument: manifest N=1 superspace; integrability input for non-wrapping part

assumed: asymptotic all-loop Bethe ansatz / dilatation operator for the range below wrapping
supersymmetric DR adequate at five loops for the needed pole parts
checked_partially: agreement with Y-system and with the conjectured twist-three formula 0901.4864

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): length-five operator at five loops, N=1 superspace, agreement with 0901.4864 and Y-system
red_flags: hybrid field-theory/integrability result; only the wrapping part is a genuine five-loop Feynman-graph computation
scheme-level SUSY preservation not discussed (abstract-level access only)
notes: The five-loop Konishi itself was NOT computed by these authors with Feynman graphs; five-loop Konishi field-theory confirmation came from correlators (Eden-Heslop-Korchemsky-Smirnov-Sokatchev 1202.5733, covered in S1c).
